scope: Conservative exact client display mappings. Unmatched narrative is left unchanged; no regex translation of player text or internal IDs.
integrationNotes: Apply NpcLines once before NPCDialog.NewText parses buttons/colours; preserve original leading/trailing whitespace when looking up a trimmed line.
Map exact NpcCaptions on captured display text only, in both normal buttons and big buttons; keep action/click targets unchanged.
NPCSegment.ParseSay resolves <$...> variables before sending. This client pack intentionally excludes variable-containing whole-line templates.
NpcCaptions and NpcLines coverage overlap and must not be added together.
Coverage inventories archived/unreferenced script variants as well as direct NPC references; it is not live gameplay acceptance.
Quest descriptions are inventoried in the corpus but are not translated comprehensively by this NPC starter pack.
